landmarks.flavor_en: The 240-metre TV tower with a clock made of lights.
All that is left of the old castle: one tower by the Rhine.
landmarks.flavor_ml: പഴയ കോട്ടയിൽ ബാക്കിയുള്ളത്: റൈനരികിലെ ഒരു ഗോപുരം.

landmarks.flavor_en: The town hall on the market square with the Elector on his horse.
The 'Kö': a posh shopping street along a canal.
The church with the famous twisted spire.
The old town street called 'the longest bar in the world'.
landmarks.flavor_ml: 'ലോകത്തിലെ ഏറ്റവും നീളമുള്ള ബാർ' എന്നറിയപ്പെടുന്ന പഴയ തെരുവ്.

landmarks.flavor_en: The riverside promenade, where everyone walks on sunny days.
